home.heroSubtitle: Gather your music and movies all in one place with Mensola. Discover your tastes, share with your friends.
home.featuresSubtitle: Mensola organizes your cultural consumption habits and turns them into a social experience.
home.feat1Desc: Save the tracks, albums, and artists you listen to. Create playlists and track your music history.
home.feat2Desc: List, rate, and review movies and series. Create your 'Watchlist' and check your friends' recommendations.
home.feat3Desc: Share your thoughts on what you watch and listen to, discuss with friends. Every content is the start of a conversation.
home.feat4Desc: See what your friends are watching and listening to in a real-time feed. Discover mutual tastes.
home.feat5Desc: Showcase your tastes and activities. Show your cultural world to your followers.
home.feat6Desc: Create special collections from your favorite movies and songs. Share your lists, discover others'.
home.soon2Desc: Personalized content recommendations based on your tastes.
home.soon3Desc: Detailed analysis of your listening and watching habits.
home.howSubtitle: Using Mensola is extremely simple. Create your account, add your favorites, discover.
home.step1Desc: Sign up in seconds. Add your profile photo, write a short bio, and you're ready.
home.step2Desc: Add your favorite music and movies. Importing from existing platforms is coming soon.
home.step3Desc: Follow your friends, see their favorites, discover new content, and share your own tastes.
home.betaSubtitle: Users accepted into the Mensola closed beta test will experience the app before anyone else and contribute to the development process. Spots are limited.

beta.subtitle: Join the waitlist to experience Mensola before anyone else. Spots are limited.

beta.privacy: No spam. We'll only notify you when your access is ready.

teaser.subtitle: Mensola, where you can log and explore your culture, arts, and entertainment experiences, is currently in closed beta.
teaser.playNotice: Mensola is currently in closed beta. We will be available on the Google Play Store very soon!
teaser.modalDesc: Mensola is currently in an invitation-only closed beta test. Our Google Play Store release will be available to everyone very soon. Join the early access waitlist today to be among the first users!
